historical_contribution_diagnosis.source_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.canonicalMeetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt,t.node_id,t.tdocNumber,
                             t.reservationDate,t.uploadedDate
             FROM Tdoc t JOIN rel_SUBMITTED_BY sub ON sub.src_id=t.node_id
             JOIN Company c ON c.node_id=sub.dst_id
             JOIN rel_RELATED_TO rel ON rel.src_id=t.node_id
             JOIN WorkItem w ON w.node_id=rel.dst_id
             JOIN rel_PRESENTED_AT at ON at.src_id=t.node_id
             JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=at.dst_id
             WHERE c.companyName=? AND w.workItemCode=?
             ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC,m.canonicalMeetingNumber,t.tdocNumber DESC
